paper_title: Revisiting the bound on axion-photon coupling from Globular Clusters
suggested_experiment_name: Globular Clusters R parameter (HB, Ayala et al. 2014)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (plot y-axis is g_agamma x 10^-10 GeV^-1; axis multiplier applied)
notes: Ayala et al. (2014) derive g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% CL from the R parameter (NHB/NRGB) of 39 Galactic Globular Clusters, using the Aver et al. He abundance Y=0.2535. This is a mass-independent astrophysical bound valid for axions/ALPs with mass below a few keV (Primakoff production in HB cores); encoded as a flat line from 1e-10 eV to 1e4 eV (~few keV upper validity). Alternative bounds under different Y assumptions: 0.50e-10 (SBBN) and 0.76e-10 (solar Y) GeV^-1 at 95% CL; the headline result 0.66e-10 is used.
